sections.overview: The Brown Skua is a large seabird of the Southern Ocean.
sections.identification: Its dark brown plumage has pale flashes on the wings.
sections.habitat: It nests near seabird colonies and winters at sea.
sections.diet: It eats seabirds, eggs and chicks, and scavenges carcasses.
sections.behavior: It is a territorial predator and scavenger that can hunt on foot or in flight.
sections.reproduction: It nests in loose colonies; the female usually lays two eggs in a ground scrape.
sections.ecology: Near colonies it hunts burrow-nesting petrels; in winter it disperses over the open ocean.
sections.conservation: Oiseaux.net reports the global IUCN category as Least Concern; local populations can still face human disturbance or persecution.
